title: Pass Context into ReminderMessage.build() call in logDose
description: ReminderMessage.build's notification title/body are being localized (task-039), which requires a Context to resolve string resources -- this call site now passes getApplication() (already available via AndroidViewModel).
acceptance_criteria: The call is ReminderMessage.build(getApplication(), medication.name, nextEligible)
Nothing else on this line or around it changes
